card.name: Scattered words in general web prose
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on ordinary words such as 'for', 'social', 'commonly', 'in' and 'we' in general web text about education or the environment.
card.plain: It responds to assorted everyday words in non-medical web text, and no pattern a reader could use was found.
